Privacy Policy

The purpose of this page is to describe our practices about collection, use and disclosure of user personal data. We are committed not to use and share information with anyone or else define in this privacy policy.


TYPE OF INFORMATION COLLECTION:


Personal information:

We don\’t gather personal information. It is an information that recognize you or another person, that may be transferred or acquired upon use of application, services and/or the website. Personal information comprises of name, address, phone, fax, SSN, email address, geographical position, information saved in device or information transfer or receive using the application, service or site.


Non Personal information:
 We may gather non-personal information regarding user when they intermingle with our applications. Non personal information consist of information regarding your devices, lists of app that are installed on device, technical information about user with an interaction with our application, like model and version of phone and other relevant information. 


COLLECTION OF INFORMATION:


Personal information:
 We don’t gather personal information; also don’t use them by any means. 


Non- Personal Information

 (1) We may use your Non- Personal Information to personalize user experiences in order to let know about interest of customer, know demographics and other trends.
 (2) We may use Non- Personal Information to recuperate services, maintain, improve, provide and adjust the Applications, Services and the Site and progress new services.
 (3) We may use non-personal information for marketing and advertisement purposes. 
 
DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION:


Personal information:
 We generally we use data usage and session give services to our user, and utilize the application, site and services to take maximum leverage. We don’t keep personal information hence we don’t reveal your personal information. 


Non-Personal Information:
 We may reveal Non-personal information to our reliable partner who will obey with privacy policy and other related privacy news. We don’t associate non-personal information with personal information. 


Third party services:
 To postulate services to user we may use wide range of third party services. We don’t have any right or control over third party services or websites. Any link to website and service appears in apps doesn’t mean we encourage them or practice user’s relevant information.


Children’s privacy policy:
 We don’t deliberately gather personally identifiable information anyone under age of 13. If you are parent or guardian be aware that children has provided us with personal data please let us know. We are oblige to remove any information from our services if we came to know that data is gather from children without permission of parents.


Security:
 We are dedicated in protection of your Personal Information, as you trust in giving us your personal information. However, please be aware that no transaction method on Internet is 100 secure altogether and we don’t assure ultimate security.
